arcs.title: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters
arcs.summary: Day 2: The Committee has identified its first substantive matter — a forty-year-old puddle at the eastern end of Diagon Alley, unmapped and unclaimed. The Subgroup on Standing Water and Comparable Phenomena has been constituted. Internal division forming between the 'Broadly Geographic' and 'Adjacent Matters' factions. Tibbs still has not replied to his non-voting invitation. Day 3 should bring the Committee closer to Christine's territory — perhaps the puddle is found to lie near a Gringotts access point, or a passing reference to vault-adjacent drainage is made in the working group's preliminary notes, putting Christine on mild, amused alert.
